jorge: Big thank you to @neha and @sam for jumping on the UX bug this morning and patching the login flow before standup :star2:

neha: team effort — sam found the race condition, I pushed the quick fix and rina verified in staging.

sam: also shoutout to @claire for catching the flaky test in CI that hid this for a week. detective work. :mag:

rina: verified and cleared smoke tests. left a note in the deploy ticket with reproduction steps.

claire: happy to help. left a tiny snippet in #eng-testing on how to mock the timing issue.

jorge: can we get these two into the weekly kudos roundup? they turned a 2-hour hit into a 5-minute save.

hrbot: Kudos recorded: KUDOS-612 for neha, sam, claire. Reward: 1 extra day of flex-time (team vote required). :sparkles:

neha: wow thanks HRbot! flex-time would be lovely.
sam: amazing — also, free coffee voucher from me to the trio. caffeine = healing. :coffee:

rina: Nomination submitted to #people-ops-noms. tossing in a screenshot of the PR and the test logs.

claire: thanks everyone. small wins keep the product going. :heart:

jorge: Ok wrap-up: party at the office kitchen Friday 4pm? small cake and confetti. CC @people-ops for cake budget.

hrbot: People Ops notified: cake request queued under REQ-88. :tada:
